snippet.title: During her terrifying breast cancer scare, she got abandonment instead of support
snippet.description:
She was facing one of the most frightening health scares of her life, but instead of the support she expected, Sharon Stone says she felt abandoned by the man who was supposed to stand beside her. 💔

During a breast tumor scare, doctors advised Sharon to consider a bilateral mastectomy because the tumors appeared serious. When she decided to take the precaution seriously, her then-husband, journalist Phil Bronstein, reportedly called the decision ridiculous and walked out of the room.

Sharon later revealed that this moment made her realize their marriage was over. They divorced in 2004. Fortunately, the tumors turned out to be benign, but the emotional impact of that experience stayed with her.

Sometimes, a difficult moment reveals just how much support a relationship truly has.
